description: This Java class 'BookUtils' provides utility methods for handling 'Book' objects, specifically combining the book's title with its series information if available.

classes.name: BookUtils
classes.description: A utility class for operations related to Book objects, including combining title and series info.

methods.name: combineTitleAndSeries
methods.description: Returns the book's title combined with its series position if available.

methods.name: bookHasSeriesPosition
methods.description: Checks if the book has a valid series position (non-null and greater than zero).

methods.name: addSeriesToTitle
methods.description: Creates an Optional containing the formatted title with series position if both are available.
